name: Veronica B. Sifuentes
office: Mountain View School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Veronica B. Sifuentes has been a member of the Mountain View School District Governing Board since 2013. She serves as the board's clerk. She works as an elementary school secretary in the Bassett Unified School District.
